title: Painleve solitons of AKNS system and irrational algebraic solitons of NLS equations
summary: A novel symmetry decomposition approach is introduced to derive the so-called ``Painlevé solitons'' of the Ablowitz-Kaup-Newell-Segur (AKNS) system. These Painlevé solitons propagate against a background governed by a Painlevé transcendent, establishing a fundamental generalization of the well-known elliptic solitons concept.
